origin.note: replica house site, from the Chubut H3 2D map (outline.json v0.1.0): Tŷ Mawr offset from the Wales estate centroid (+271.8 m E, -213.0 m N, azimuthal equidistant) applied to the Chubut centroid

frame: x = metres east of the origin, z = metres south (three.js), equirectangular at the origin latitude

near.decode: (R*256+G)/10-20 metres above sea level; B=255 sea

far.decode: (R*256+G)/10-20; B=255 sea; lowered 4 m inside the near box

buildings.layout: BLD1, uint32 count, then per building int16 x*2, int16 z*2, uint16 w*10, uint16 l*10, uint8 angle (0-255 = 0-180 deg, about +y), uint8 height*4

sources: Terrain: Terrain Tiles (Mapzen/Linux Foundation, on AWS Open Data; SRTM and other public sources), read 11 Nov 2026
Buildings: Microsoft Global ML Building Footprints (ODbL, release 2026-02-03), plus OpenStreetMap buildings not in that set
Coastline and roads: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL), read 11 Nov 2026
